The [[Eternal Empire]] had a network of '''agents''' which they used to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on the outlands, a [[Zakuulan]] term for the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[war against Zakuul]]. [[Watcher Izax]] was considered to be most successful of these [[Agent/Legends|agents]] until he abandoned [[Zakuul]] permanently to live in the outlands.<ref name="KOTET 6" />
